title: Menu

toast.subcatNotEmpty: Move or remove its {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} first

hiddenNotice.title: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} not visible to customers
hiddenNotice.body: {count, plural, one {It won’t appear on your ordering page until its allergens are confirmed — showing a dish with unchecked allergen info would read as “allergen-free”. empty.title: Build your menu in seconds
empty.body: Take a photo of your menu board, screenshot your existing menu, or drag in a PDF — our AI will extract everything and build your digital menu automatically.
empty.note: Works with photos, screenshots, PDFs and plain text. You can review and edit everything before it’s saved.

category.countsTitle: Counts toward the kitchen-capacity limit (set in Menu → Kitchen capacity)
category.allowNotesHelp: Truck can always note; this is for customers
category.prepHelp: Set to Instant for items like drinks or dips. These won’t count toward kitchen capacity.

uncategorized.title: Uncategorized
uncategorized.body: ⚠ No category set — pick one (✏️) so each shows in its section. They’re still live on the order screens until then.

newCategory.title: New category
newCategory.notesHelp: Lets customers add a note to each item (e.g. “no onion”). The truck can always add item notes regardless. All orders also have an order-level notes field.

allergens.heading: Allergens
allergens.buildFirst: Build your menu first — add dishes, then set up their allergens
allergens.cardNotAllowed: An allergen card on its own can’t be used where your truck trades, so customers see allergens against each dish. Please confirm each dish’s allergens.
allergens.addCard: add an allergen card so customers can see allergen info
allergens.viewOnly: View only — only the owner can edit allergens
allergens.uploadIntro: Upload your allergen card or paste your allergen information. Our AI will extract and structure it clearly for customers.
allergens.dragOrTap: Drag and drop or tap to upload
allergens.needReview: {count, plural, one {# dish needs} other {# dishes need}} review — customers can’t see allergen info until confirmed

deleteItem.title: Remove {name}?
deleteItem.history: Historical orders containing this item are preserved.
deleteItem.body: This item will be hidden from your menu immediately. It won’t appear on the customer order page or in the Add order panel.

item.createHint: Fill in the details, then add the item.
item.ingredientsHelp: Shown to customers on the order page
item.subcatHelp: Groups this item under a heading within its category on the order screens — e.g. Meat Lovers, Veggie. Leave blank for none.
item.optionsHelp: Tick a group to offer it on this dish, then choose which of its options to show.
item.optionLocked: A required group needs at least one option for each dish
item.optionOffered: Offered — tap to hide on this dish
item.optionHidden: Hidden — tap to offer on this dish
item.allergenGateTitle: Set up allergens for this dish in the allergen review.
item.allergenGateBody: Open the “Set up / review allergens” box on the Menu tab — the wizard walks each dish through confirmation.
item.photoHint: Square photos work best. JPG or PNG.
item.preorderHelp: Include this item in pre-orders. Timing & rule are set globally in Settings → Pre-orders.
item.noGroups: No option groups yet — create them in Extras & upsells.

summary: {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}} · {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

confirmDelete.withItems: Delete “{name}”? This will also delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in this category. This cannot be undone.
